dimensions.assessment: Applies nationally to individuals transporting knives across state lines or through various jurisdictions, as well as state and local law enforcement agencies.
dimensions.evidence: any individual who is not otherwise prohibited by Federal law from possessing, transporting, shipping, or receiving a knife or knives shall be entitled to transport a knife or knives

dimensions.assessment: Protects individuals from arrest or detention under state or local laws if they comply with federal transport standards and provides a civil right of action against state or local actors for deprivation of rights.
dimensions.evidence: An individual who is transporting a knife or knives in compliance with this section may not be arrested or otherwise detained for violation of any law

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue changes are specified, though potential litigation costs could affect state and local governments under the right of action.
Pre-empts state and local prohibitions regarding knife transport and creates a new federal statutory defense, claim, and right of action.
dimensions.evidence: Notwithstanding any provision of any law or any rule or regulation of the United States, or of a State or any political subdivision of a State

dimensions.assessment: Permanent nationwide pre-emption of state and local rules regarding interstate knife transportation.

missing_information: Estimates of potential legal costs or case volumes resulting from civil actions against states and local governments.
importance_detail.rationale: The Knife Owners' Protection Act of 2025 permits individuals to transport knives interstate under specific secure storage and accessibility rules, pre-empts state and local knife transport laws, restricts arrests and detentions for compliant transport, and establishes a private right of action for violations.
